title: OpenCoreImage Embedded WASM completion audit
scope: OpenCoreImage CIContext initialization and rendering contracts
Swift 6.4 ordinary and Embedded WASM compile/link behavior

root_causes.cause: OpenCoreGraphics re-exported Foundation-owned geometry, bytes, URL, and math APIs that are absent in Embedded Swift.
root_causes.resolution: Add OpenCoreGraphicsSupport and COpenCoreGraphicsSupport, then route shared sources through one portable import boundary.

root_causes.cause: JavaScriptKit promise result extensions were used without importing JavaScriptEventLoop.
root_causes.resolution: Import JavaScriptEventLoop at the three promise call sites and SwiftWebGPU error bridge.

root_causes.cause: Instantiating CIContext pulls the Embedded concurrency runtime, whose C++ virtual dispatch requires libc++abi at executable link time.
root_causes.resolution: Link c++abi explicitly for the Embedded smoke executable.

verification.result: release build and 14 Chromium WebGPU checks passed
CIContext initialization and 5-byte file round trip passed

limits: The Embedded Node smoke does not provide WebGPU; GPU pixel semantics are verified separately in Chromium.
Typed factory methods without a concrete per-filter conformance still return nil and produce Embedded restriction warnings.
OpenCoreImage still has explicitly marked incomplete Core Image API areas; this audit does not claim full Apple Core Image semantic parity.
The Embedded NSAttributedString compatibility type currently carries only its immutable plain string.
